title: The Helpful Stranger
intro: Evening, Toddy. Your phone just buzzed.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what's suspicious, clear what's harmless.
When you're sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Hi there! 👋 We saw your post. Your wallet is out of sync…

banner.text: New message request · you don't follow this account

screen.context: Earlier you posted in the Northvale community chat: "My swap is stuck 😩 anyone know why?"

msg: We saw your post. Your wallet is out of sync, so your swap is frozen.

dm_first.label: They messaged first
dm_first.lens: You never contacted them. They found your public post and messaged you first.
dm_first.why: Real support teams don't slide into your DMs. Scammers watch public help posts.

tick.label: Fake tick
tick.lens: The ✔ is just an emoji typed into the name. Wrenly's real verified badge sits after the handle, and there isn't one.
tick.why: Anyone can type a tick into a display name.

handle.label: 2-day-old account
handle.lens: Joined 2 days ago · 3 followers. The official account is @northvale.
handle.why: Brand-new look-alike accounts are a classic impersonation sign.

link.label: Look-alike link
link.lens: This link really goes to northvale-sync.help, not the official northvale.app.
link.why: Always check where a link really goes. Look-alike sites steal your details.

phrase.label: Asks for recovery phrase
phrase.lens: Whoever has your recovery phrase controls your wallet, forever.
phrase.why: No real support team ever asks for your recovery phrase.

timer.label: Countdown pressure
timer.lens: A countdown that pushes you to act before you think.
timer.why: Rushing you is a pressure trick. Real fixes don't expire in 15 minutes.

avatar.label: Moon logo
avatar.why: A logo is easy to copy, so it proves nothing either way on its own.

time.label: Sent at 2:14 AM
time.why: Messages arrive at all hours. The time alone proves nothing.

greeting.label: Friendly hello
greeting.lens: A friendly hello and a wave.
greeting.why: Being friendly isn't suspicious by itself.

trap.title: Northvale Wallet Sync
trap.ask: Enter your 12-word recovery phrase to re-sync your wallet.

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. Wrenly removed the fake account, so it can't fool the next person.

verify.line: Northvale's help page says: "We never message you first and never ask for your recovery phrase." Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the account is still out there messaging other people.

go_ahead.line: Mirage used the phrase to empty the wallet in seconds. In real life, that money is gone for good.

what_if.go_ahead: If you'd blocked and reported instead, the account would be gone and your vault still full.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and gets the fake account removed before it reaches someone else.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Blocking and reporting as well gets the account removed for everyone.

golden_rule: No real support team will ever ask for your recovery phrase.

quick_check.q: A "Support" account asks for your 12-word recovery phrase to fix your wallet. What do you do?

options.text: Share it, but only if they have a ✔
Never share it. Block and report.
Ask them to call you first

quick_check.explain: Your recovery phrase is the master key. Nobody real ever needs it, not even part of it.

hints.nudge: Start with who sent it. Do you know this account?

rows.v: None. The ✔ is typed into the name

rows.k: Do they ask for your recovery phrase?
